findings.evidence: Two iron straps with horizontal hinge barrels are mounted mid-height on the front face, but a lid pivots at the back edge, so hinges drawn here could never work.
The spec calls for exactly two hinges on the back edge and one latch at the front center, yet the render shows four hinge-like fittings, adding an extra pair of hinges flanking the front latch.
